sous_titre: Montants remportés, en millions de dollars, enchère close en juin 2026

Verizon.texte: Verizon bid through its subsidiary Cellco Partnership and secured 82 licenses for a total of $3.16 billion.

T-Mobile.texte: T-Mobile won 102 licenses for a total of $277.8 million, giving it the largest license count.

AT&T.texte: AT&T picked up 10 licenses for a total of $120.8 million.

SpaceX.texte: SpaceX, through its Space Exploration Holdings entity, also won two licenses, paying $8.5 million.
